title: 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT Emission-Control Reference
introduction: For the 5.2L 32V Ti-VCT, the emission-control explanation continues in the separate PC/ED manual. I treat these pointers like the index tabs in a workshop binder: one takes you to the system's operation, the other to its components. This page directs that reading; it does not supply the underlying explanation, diagnostic tests or repair steps.

edits.text: For system operation, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
edits.why: The operating explanation belongs to this required reference. Its contents are not included here.

edits.text: For component descriptions, consult the Powertrain Control/Emissions Diagnosis (PC/ED) manual, Section 1, Description and Operation.
